title: OL-20261121-1: Four keyless superseded GitHub Apps stay installed
body:
**Owner:** tick-worker
**Trigger:** daily app-audit row
**Done check:** file:ops/connections/github-apps.json
**Status:** open

APP-INVENTORY-1: the tick step app-audit prunes extra installations of the two active apps and records credential_events app-audit. The four superseded apps hold no key, so only the owning account's GitHub settings can remove them (identity-bound); default in effect: installed and inert.
